description: A long burgundy open-front noble outer coat with gold geometric, floral and small heraldic-animal motifs along the front, hem and sleeve borders. It is layered over a dark patterned long tunic and a cream undershirt visible at the wrists. An ornate clasp joins the high collar, and a dark belt with an ornate metal buckle secures the waist, with a narrow hanging end. The outer sleeves are broad, exposing the cream fitted inner sleeves. Brown trousers and tall dark brown boots complete the outfit. Textiles are rich-looking and matte; exact fibres cannot be confirmed.
